findings.evidenceJa: なそれは本気ですか、シロウ
findings.explanation: The startled break is fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: Andif you take out the sheath, what will you do?
findings.evidenceJa: それに鞘を摘出してしまったら、シロウはどうするのです
findings.governingReading: And if the sheath is extracted, what will become of you, Shirou?
findings.explanation: The conjunction is fused and Saber’s concern for Shirou’s resulting condition becomes an odd question about his action.

findings.highlight: We need to do this to win
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちが勝つ為の、絶対の条件だ
findings.governingReading: This is an absolute condition for us to win.
findings.explanation: The categorical condition is weakened to generic necessity.

findings.evidenceJa: 空を覆っていた雲が流れ
findings.governingReading: The clouds covering the sky drift away.
findings.explanation: Movement opening the moonlight becomes disappearance.

findings.evidenceJa: 迷いを断って、セイバーは頷いてくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber cuts through her hesitation and nods.
findings.explanation: Her difficult act of resolve disappears.
A spoken transition into the procedure becomes a redundant act of agreement.

findings.evidenceJa: 形のない、しかし原型に戻った魔力の束
findings.governingReading: The formless cluster of magical energy, nevertheless restored to its original pattern.
findings.explanation: The apparent paradox and restored archetypal state disappear.

findings.highlight: The magic surely kills my body every time I use it
findings.evidenceJa: 使えば確実に身体を侵していく魔術
findings.governingReading: Magecraft that surely encroaches on and ravages his body whenever used.
findings.explanation: Progressive bodily damage becomes literal repeated killing.

findings.highlight: the only way to help Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに報いる方法
findings.explanation: Reciprocity and debt become generic assistance.

findings.highlight: The golden sheath suited to the king who ran through many battles
findings.evidenceJa: 戦場を行く騎士王に相応しい黄金の鞘
findings.governingReading: The golden sheath befitting the Knight King who crosses battlefields.
findings.explanation: Saber’s title and stately movement are weakened into running through battles.

findings.highlight: I take what protected the king and led her to numerous victories and reproduce it vividly without any mistake
findings.evidenceJa: 主を守り、幾たびもの勝利をもたらした証を、鮮明に、狂いもなく、あの時の美しさのままで
findings.governingReading: He reproduces the proof that protected its master and brought many victories, vivid, exact, and as beautiful as then.
findings.explanation: The sheath as proof, its master relation, and preservation of beauty disappear.

findings.highlight: I engrave it into my mind
findings.governingReading: burn it forever into this heart
findings.explanation: The emotional heart is changed to cognitive memory.

findings.highlight: Something that was binding my body for a long time escapes my body
findings.evidenceJa: 長く自分を縛っていた物が抜けていく
findings.governingReading: Something that had long bound him is leaving his body.
findings.explanation: A bodily extraction is personified as escape.

findings.evidenceJa: 会心の手応えだったのか
findings.governingReading: Perhaps she felt the deeply satisfying certainty of success.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference about Saber’s felt response becomes an assertion about objective perfection.

findings.evidenceJa: ぺたん、と地面に座り込む
findings.governingReading: He drops flat into a seated position on the ground.
findings.explanation: A controlled collapse into sitting becomes a comic fall.

findings.highlight: that which was part of me until now
findings.governingReading: that which had been his other half
findings.explanation: The sheath’s intimate status as half the self is weakened to an unspecified part.
